title: Rain check
setting: A text-turned-quick-call between two friends. Maya is inviting Chris to dinner tomorrow.
situationZh: 两个朋友。Maya 约 Chris 明天吃饭，Chris 想婉拒，但不想让人觉得被冷落。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Hey, a few of us are getting dinner tomorrow. You wanna come?
lines.spoken: Hey, a few of us are getting dinner tomorrow. You wanna come?
lines.meaningZh: 嗨，我们几个人明天吃饭。你要来吗？

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Tomorrow... I don't think I can. I've got this thing I have to finish.
lines.spoken: Tomorrow... I don't think I can. I've got this thing I have to finish.
lines.meaningZh: 明天……我恐怕不行。我有件事得先做完。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: We can do a later time, if that helps.
lines.spoken: We can do a later time, if that helps.
lines.meaningZh: 我们可以再晚一点，如果这样对你方便的话。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I appreciate that. I think I'm just gonna take a rain check, though.
lines.spoken: I appreciate that. I think I'm just gonna take a rain check, though.
lines.meaningZh: 谢谢你这么说。不过我还是想改天吧。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, next week should be better. Thanks for asking.
lines.spoken: Yeah, next week should be better. Thanks for asking.
lines.meaningZh: 嗯，下周应该可以。谢谢你邀我。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: We will. Don't work too late, okay?
lines.spoken: We will. Don't work too late, okay?
lines.meaningZh: 会的。别工作得太晚，好吗？

gist.askEn: What is Maya inviting him to?

details.askZh: Maya 提议改时间后，Chris 还是怎么说的？
details.askEn: After Maya offers a later time, what does Chris say?

glue.span: I'm just gonna take a rain check
glue.hear: I'm just gonna take a rain check
glue.noteZh: gonna take a 连得很紧，rain check 是固定说法，不是在说天气。
glue.standard: I am just going to take a rain check

glue.noteZh: don't 的 t 常常丢掉，think I can 会缩成 thinkI can，否定有时只靠 don't 里剩下的那一点鼻音。
glue.standard: I do not think I can

chunks.sayAfter: Tomorrow? I don't think I can.

chunks.meaningZh: 谢谢你这么说 / 领情。
chunks.sayAfter: I appreciate that. I think I'm gonna take a rain check.
I think I'm just gonna take a rain check, though.

roleplay.setupZh: 朋友约你明天吃饭。你真的去不了，想婉拒，但希望听起来领情，并且留下下周的可能。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, a warm friend who invited you. She may offer a later time, and she will not guilt you if you decline kindly.
variants: She suggests lunch instead of dinner.
It's a birthday, not a casual dinner.
You already have plans with family.
starters: Tomorrow... I don't think I can.
Yeah, next week should be better.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲朋友怎么约你、你为什么没去、最后怎么说的。准备 15 秒，然后说 60 秒，再更短、更快地说两遍。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the story of the invitation and how you took a rain check. Prep 15 seconds, then speak for 60, then 45, then 30.
